published.citation: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 162003: effective temperature in K, from the angular diameter and the bolometric flux, 6014 +/- 90: 6014 +/- 90 K, https://doi.org/10.1088/0004-637X/746/1/101

temperature.note: No archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: HD 162003 is not in the library; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: HR 6636 is not in the catalogue; kiehling: HR 6636 is not among its 60 stars; kharitonov: HR 6636 is not in the catalogue; burnashev: BS 6636 is not in part2), so the color is a Planck spectrum at its published temperature.
